subject: Halloween weekend: free trick-or-treating, Zoo Boo's last days and more
preheader: Welcome to the first Littles List. Plus a library Halloween party tonight.
intro: Welcome to the very first Littles List! Every Thursday, we'll round up the best things to do with babies through elementary schoolers in Spring Branch and Memorial: storytimes, festivals, parks and kids-eat-free nights, each one checked against the organizer's own page.

It's Halloween weekend, so this one is all about costumes. Our pick is CityCentre's free trick-or-treat on Friday evening (bring your own bucket). Need a plan for tonight? The Spring Branch Memorial Library is throwing a Halloween party for kids 4 to 8, from 5 to 7.
Know a parent who'd like this? Forward it along. And if we missed something, just hit reply. We read every one.
